```{r load-packages, include false}
            )
```
 
## Get US immigration data
```{r read-data, echo=FALSE}
## read the data in a file online
file <- "https://ohss.dhs.gov/system/files/2026-06/2026_0604_ohss_yearbook_lawful_permanent_residents_fy2024.xlsx"
perm_res  <- import(file, which = 2, skip = 5, trust  = TRUE)
#file <- "https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/lung-cancer-death-rates-males.csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true"
#file_cancer  <- import(file, trust  = TRUE)


perm_res <- perm_res %>%
  # 1. Convert all columns to numeric first
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  
  # 2. Rename pairs cleanly in ONE pass (Odd = Year, Even = Number)
  rename_with(function(cols) {
    pair_id <- (seq_along(cols) + 1) %/% 2
    type <- ifelse(seq_along(cols) %% 2 != 0, "Year", "Number")
    paste0(type, "_", pair_id)
  }) %>%
  
  # 3. Pivot pairs into unified columns
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c(".value", "pair"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  
  # 4. Cleanup
  dplyr::select(Year, Number) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  arrange(Year)

perm_res <- perm_res %>%
  mutate(Cumulative = cumsum(Number))

glimpse(perm_res)
```

## plot US immigration data
```{r read-data, echo=FALSE}
plot_perm_res <- plot_ly(
  data = perm_res,
  x = ~Year,
  y = ~Cumulative,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  line = list(color = "#2b5c8f", width = 2),
  marker = list(size = 6, color = "#2b5c8f"),
  hovertemplate = "<b>Year:</b> %{x}<br><b>Number:</b> %{y:,}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Number by Year", font = list(size = 18)),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year", gridcolor = "#e5e5e5"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number", gridcolor = "#e5e5e5"),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    paper_bgcolor = "#ffffff",
    plot_bgcolor = "#fafafa"
  )
plot_perm_res
```

```{r read-data, echo=FALSE}
)

us_migrant_stock <- read.csv(csv_url, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Cleanup the data
names(us_migrant_stock) <- gsub("_", ".", names(us_migrant_stock))
names(us_migrant_stock) <- tolower(names(us_migrant_stock))
glimpse(us_migrant_stock)

# Get all migrant stock
us_migrant_stock <- us_migrant_stock %>%
  filter(ref.area == "USA") %>%
  group_by(time.period) %>%
  summarise(
    migrant_stock = sum(obs.value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(time.period)
```
